name: Scrape a marketplace and sell leads or a value-add service to one side
one_liner: Scrape Craigslist-style listings with an AI scraper, then sell matched leads to 'wanted' buyers per lead, or message sellers with a cheap service that raises their item's value.
customer: Buyers posting 'wanted' ads (flippers, collectors); private sellers; B2B businesses found by scraping
offer: Pay-per-lead alerts to buyers (~$5/lead suggested) or a low-price digital service to sellers
evidence: Presenter's old A/B test: scraped locked-iPhone listings and emailed sellers $10 vs $20 unlock offers, fulfilled by an eBay supplier at $5 each; it 'eventually died' – SQ-OSmDMsFI
Later scraped 20,000 US iPhone repair shops and had virtual assistants cold-call them for a parts wholesale business 'worth over $10 million' sold in 2019 – SQ-OSmDMsFI

risks: Craigslist is small in the UK/Portugal (Gumtree/OLX/Facebook instead)
